description_en: Submits a custom rule for testing
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem post-customize-rule-test --id 123456789 --test-type simulate --simulated-data key1_:_value1_,_key2_:_value2_,_key3_:_value3_,_key4_:_value4_,_key5_:_value5 --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PostCustomizeRuleTest

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom rule
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The test type. Valid values:

simulate: tests the rule with simulated data

business: tests the rule with business data
parameters.help_zh:
测试类型。取值：
simulate：模拟数据测试
business：业务数据测试
parameters.name: test_type

parameters.help_en: The simulated data for the test. This parameter is required only when TestType is set to simulate
parameters.help_zh: 模拟测试数据，只有在测试类型为simulate情况下赋值
parameters.name: simulated_data

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member that the administrator wants to impersonate to view data
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center of threat analysis is located. Select the region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

Code.description_en: The status code of the request

Data.description_en: The return value of the request

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
Success.title_zh:
请求是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
